title: The Ten Commandments

questions.question: What is the first commandment?
options: You shall have no other gods before me
questions.correctAnswer: You shall have no other gods before me
questions.explanation: Exodus 20:3 (ESV): "You shall have no other gods before me."

questions.question: What does the fifth commandment say?
options: Honor your father and your mother
questions.correctAnswer: Honor your father and your mother
questions.explanation: Exodus 20:12 (ESV): "Honor your father and your mother."

questions.question: What does the sixth commandment prohibit?
What is the fourth commandment about?
options: Remembering the Sabbath day to keep it holy
questions.correctAnswer: Remembering the Sabbath day to keep it holy
questions.explanation: Exodus 20:8 (ESV): "Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy."

questions.question: What does the eighth commandment prohibit?
What does the second commandment forbid?
questions.explanation: Exodus 20:4 (ESV): "You shall not make for yourself a carved image, or any likeness of anything that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath."

questions.question: What does the third commandment say about God's name?
options: You shall not take the name of the Lord your God in vain
questions.correctAnswer: You shall not take the name of the Lord your God in vain
questions.explanation: Exodus 20:7 (ESV): "You shall not take the name of the Lord your God in vain, for the Lord will not hold him guiltless who takes his name in vain."

questions.question: What does the tenth commandment prohibit?
options: Coveting your neighbor's house, wife, or possessions
questions.correctAnswer: Coveting your neighbor's house, wife, or possessions
questions.explanation: Exodus 20:17 (ESV): "You shall not covet your neighbor's house; you shall not covet your neighbor's wife..."

questions.question: Why did God give the reason He rested on the seventh day?
options: In six days the Lord made heaven and earth and rested the seventh day
questions.correctAnswer: In six days the Lord made heaven and earth and rested the seventh day
questions.explanation: Exodus 20:11 (ESV): "For in six days the Lord made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them, and rested on the seventh day."

questions.question: What promise is attached to the commandment to honor parents?
options: That your days may be long in the land
questions.correctAnswer: That your days may be long in the land
questions.explanation: Exodus 20:12 (ESV): "Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land."

questions.question: How does God describe Himself in showing mercy according to the second commandment?
options: Showing steadfast love to thousands of those who love Him and keep His commandments
questions.correctAnswer: Showing steadfast love to thousands of those who love Him and keep His commandments
questions.explanation: Exodus 20:6 (ESV): "Showing steadfast love to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments."

questions.question: What did the people do when they witnessed the thunder and lightning?
options: They trembled and stood far off
questions.correctAnswer: They trembled and stood far off
questions.explanation: Exodus 20:18 (ESV): "Now when all the people saw the thunder and the flashes of lightning... the people were afraid and trembled, and they stood far off."

questions.question: What did Moses say about why God came with such fearful signs?
options: To test you, that the fear of him may be before you so you do not sin
questions.correctAnswer: To test you, that the fear of him may be before you so you do not sin
questions.explanation: Exodus 20:20 (ESV): "Do not fear, for God has come to test you, that the fear of him may be before you, that you may not sin."

questions.question: What instructions did God give about building an altar?
options: Make it of earth; if of stones, do not use hewn stones
questions.correctAnswer: Make it of earth; if of stones, do not use hewn stones
questions.explanation: Exodus 20:24-25 (ESV): "An altar of earth you shall make for me... If you make me an altar of stone, you shall not build it of hewn stones."

questions.question: What does God describe Himself as in the second commandment regarding iniquity?
options: A jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children to the third and fourth generation
questions.correctAnswer: A jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children to the third and fourth generation
questions.explanation: Exodus 20:5 (ESV): "For I the Lord your God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children to the third and the fourth generation."

key_verse_text: You shall have no other gods before me.
